description: You are a management analyst performing a BPMN 2.0 compliance audit. A procurement workflow diagram has been flagged as non-compliant. Open ~/Diagrams/procurement_process.drawio in draw.io and review the diagram alongside the audit checklist at ~/Desktop/bpmn_audit_checklist.txt. Identify and correct all BPMN 2.0 violations present in the diagram. The corrected diagram must: (1) have properly separated swimlane lanes representing each organizational role involved (Requester, Budget Owner/Manager, Procurement Officer, Finance/AP — minimum 4 lanes), (2) use the correct BPMN gateway type for decision points, (3) have labeled sequence flows on all gateway exits showing the condition (e.g., Approved / Rejected), (4) include a rejection path with a notification task and end event, (5) replace any incorrectly typed intermediate events with the correct BPMN element type, (6) include labeled data objects associated with key tasks, and (7) label the start event. When complete, export the corrected diagram as a PDF to ~/Diagrams/procurement_process.pdf and as a PNG to ~/Diagrams/procurement_process.png. Login: username ga, password password123.
